# EnvBook (Env Book)

> The Zero-Knowledge Developer Workspace, Notion-Style Block Editor & Bulk .env Secrets Manager.
> Canonical URL: https://envbook.vercel.app

## Overview
EnvBook is a private, client-side encrypted developer productivity platform that bridges the gap between engineering documentation and environment variable configuration. It provides a Notion-style inline WYSIWYG block editor alongside a bulk `.env` manager, protected by zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Notion-Style Inline Block Editor
- Inline rich text canvas powered by Tiptap and ProseMirror.
- Keyboard-driven slash commands (`/`):
  - Headings (H1, H2, H3), blockquotes, code blocks with syntax highlighting
  - Bulleted, numbered, and interactive task / checklists
  - Interactive tables and horizontal dividers
  - Direct workspace creation commands (`/page`, `/section`)
- Markdown shortcuts (`#`, `- `, `1. `, ```` `, `> `) transformed in real time.
- Debounced autosave (1000ms) with visual status indicators.

### 2. Bulk .env Credential Manager & Parsing Engine
- Multiline `.env` block importer: paste complete configurations in one action.
- Robust dotenv parsing:
  - Supports LF and CRLF line breaks
  - Strips comments (`#`) and trailing whitespace
  - Splits exclusively on first `=` to preserve complex tokens, URLs (`://`), query strings (`?`, `&`), and nested secrets
  - Unescapes single and double-quoted values (`"value"`, `'value'`)
  - Validates key names against `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`
  - In-batch duplicate detection and existing database key collision resolution
- Individual variable management:
  - Key and masked value (`••••••••••••`) default display
  - Individual reveal/hide with 15-second automatic re-masking timeout
  - One-click clipboard copy with feedback
  - Inline editing and deletion with confirmation
  - Safe key search without exposing decrypted secrets in memory or logs
  - Environment Parity Matrix & Diff View across dev, staging, and prod

### 3. Zero-Knowledge Cryptographic Architecture
- Key Derivation: Argon2id / PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, SHA-256) deriving Key Encryption Key (KEK).
- Data Encryption: AES-256-GCM with unique 96-bit initialization vectors (IV / nonce) per entry.
- Plaintext secrets and user master passwords never leave the client browser.
- Encrypted ciphertext, IVs, auth tags, and salts are stored at rest in MongoDB.
- Cryptographic zeroing and memory hygiene upon vault locking.

### 4. Dynamic Hierarchical Workspace
- Four native item types:
  - `notes_page`: Leaf document with block editor
  - `section`: Standard folder / container
  - `environment_page`: Dedicated .env secrets page
  - `notes_section`: Structured notes container
- User-defined tree navigation with drag/drop, quick item creation (`+`), and contextual options.

## Deployment & Verification
- Hosted on Vercel: https://envbook.vercel.app
- Backend: Integrated Next.js App Router API endpoints with MongoDB persistence.
- Open Source repository: https://github.com/Shadab-2604/envbook
